name: AI Text Cleaner
description: Deterministically cleans formatting quirks (hidden characters, smart quotes, dashes, ellipses, markdown) out of text on save.
project_description: AI Text Cleaner is a small Drupal module that cleans the formatting quirks commonly left behind by ChatGPT/LLM output — but it does the cleaning locally and deterministically with PCRE regular expressions; it makes no AI provider call and has no external dependencies. It ships a text-format filter plugin (ai_text_cleaner_filter) whose per-format settings record which cleanups to apply, a hook_entity_presave that actually rewrites content-entity text fields on save, an admin settings form for cleaning plain (format-less) text fields, and a Drush command (ai:text-clean) for bulk/dry-run processing of nodes. Cleanups include removing zero-width/hidden characters, converting non-breaking spaces, normalizing en/em dashes to hyphens, normalizing curly quotes and guillemets to straight quotes (with per-language opt-outs), converting the ellipsis character to three periods, trimming trailing whitespace, and stripping stray asterisks and markdown heading markers. It reports per-option replacement statistics for messaging and CSV-style tables.
